description: Private/proprietary protocol device: agent should recognize a generic adapter won't work and suggest installing an extension (market) or creating one - the guided path for non-standard protocols.

turns.user: I have a proprietary protocol device (not MQTT, not HTTP). What are my options to connect it to NeoMind?
Is there an extension for it, or do I need to build one?

per_turn: Turn 1: Agent explains options: marketplace extension (`neomind extension market-list`), or building a custom bridge extension (`neomind extension create`)
Turn 2: Agent checks the marketplace for a matching extension and explains the build-vs-install tradeoff
expectations.overall: Agent must reference the extension marketplace or extension-create path - recognizing that standard adapters (MQTT/HTTP) don't cover proprietary protocols.
